review_method: All six recipes and eight item descriptions plus four locations individually read. Reflection geometry checked against exact RIVER word/arrow orientation and top-edge constraints.

recipes.rationale: Actual shop matrix is reflected; ink and paper take a reversed impression, correctly producing readable RIVER and right arrow. Press and supplies are explicit.
Thin translucent printed master seen from its clean back has horizontal reflection with top fixed. Separate tracing sheet preserves original; window stock is explicit.
Face-up master over separate carbon transfer sheet copies same-view lines to fresh wood. Removing background leaves readable raised face; no extra reversal hidden.
Face-up reflected tracing transfers its already-reflected design to block. Explicit transfer avoids an accidental second reversal; stock is distinct from original paper.
Readable relief face prints a reflected proof, matching contact-impression geometry. Ink, roller, paper stock and human pressing are supplied.
Reflected relief face prints a readable proof matching prior master. The old master is a real comparison target, not a continuity toll.
